newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony says agent will assemble TVs in Uzbekistan.
newsitem.headline: Sony says agent will assemble TVs in Uzbekistan.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Thursday that its sales agent would begin to assemble colour televisions in Uzbekistan from August or September.
A company spokesman said Sony would export cathode-ray tubes from its plant in Britain and other parts from its factory in Germany to its sales agent in Tashkent.
He said assembly would start in August or September and that output by the end of March was expected to total about 20,000 units.
The sales agent could assemble up to 36,000 units in the year from April 1, 1998, and about 50,000 units the following year, he said.
Sony wants to assemble the TVs in Uzbekistan because of high demand there and because import tariffs on parts are much lower than on assembled TVs, he said.
Sony expects to produce a total of 12.5 million colour TVs worldwide in the year to March 31, the spokesman said.
